notes: Little Caesars publishes whole-pizza and whole-order figures only (US nutrition guide, CR0027232, also shown as images at https://littlecaesars.com/en-us/menu/nutrition/). Per-slice entries are the published whole large pizza divided by 8; the guide itself implies 8 slices for a large Detroit-Style Deep Dish (4-slice lunch combo = 1390 cal, half of the 2770-cal whole), and the 8-slice cut for large round pizzas is the standard Little Caesars cut but is not printed in the guide. Thin Crust and Slices-N-Stix have no per-slice entry. Wing, bread-stick and dip figures are published per 8-piece order, per 8/10/3-piece order and per container respectively. Items the guide lists without numbers (Pretzel Crust with Pizza Sauce and Cheese, Old World Fanceroni Pepperoni, Little Caesars Cookies, Zap Pak, Parmesan Cheese Packet) are omitted.
